name: MartinGaleBreakout
summary: This EA combines a breakout trading strategy with a Martingale position sizing system. It enters trades on price breakouts of defined ranges and doubles the lot size after each consecutive loss, aiming to recover previous losses with a single winning trade. The strategy inherently carries exponential risk due to the Martingale progression.
summary_zh: 该EA结合了突破交易策略与马丁格尔仓位管理系统。在价格突破定义区间时入场，每次亏损后手数翻倍，试图用一次盈利回收之前所有亏损。由于马丁格尔递进机制，该策略天然具有指数级风险。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是突破交易结合马丁格尔资金管理。入场条件为价格突破预先设定的区间或通道上轨/下轨，突破上轨做多，突破下轨做空。出场条件依赖于止盈目标，当价格达到设定的TP时平仓获利；止损也可能存在但通常设置较宽以避免频繁触发。仓位管理采用经典马丁格尔法：初始手数开仓，若该笔交易亏损则下一笔交易手数翻倍，若再次亏损则继续翻倍，直到盈利后重置为初始手数。资金管理方面，由于手数呈指数增长，账户资金需要足够支撑多轮连续亏损，否则面临爆仓风险。整体而言，该策略在震荡市中表现极差，连续亏损会迅速耗尽保证金。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA combines breakout trading with Martingale money management. Entry conditions are based on price breaking above or below a predefined range or channel boundary — a breakout above the upper boundary triggers a buy, while a breakout below the lower boundary triggers a sell. Exit conditions rely on a take-profit target; positions are closed when price reaches the set TP level, while stop-loss may exist but is typically set wide to avoid frequent triggering. Position sizing employs the classic Martingale method: starting with an initial lot size, the lot size is doubled after each losing trade, and continues doubling on consecutive losses until a win occurs, at which point the lot size resets to the initial value. In terms of money management, since lot sizes grow exponentially, the account must have sufficient capital to withstand multiple consecutive losses or face margin call. Overall, this strategy performs poorly in choppy markets where consecutive losses can rapidly deplete the entire account balance.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和参数化调整
突破入场在趋势明确时能捕捉较大行情
马丁格尔机制在理论上可以通过一次盈利覆盖所有前序亏损
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and parameterize
Breakout entries can capture significant moves when trends are well-defined
The Martingale mechanism theoretically allows recovery of all prior losses with a single win
cons: 马丁格尔手数指数增长，连续亏损会迅速耗尽账户资金导致爆仓
突破策略在震荡市中频繁产生虚假突破信号，导致连续亏损
缺乏有效的风控机制限制最大回撤，资金曲线呈锯齿状下行趋势
未考虑点差和滑点对短线突破交易的影响，实际表现可能远低于回测
cons_en: Martingale lot sizing grows exponentially — consecutive losses can rapidly deplete account funds leading to margin call
Breakout strategy generates frequent false signals in choppy/ranging markets, causing consecutive losing trades
Lacks effective risk control mechanisms to limit maximum drawdown; equity curve tends toward a sawtooth decline
Does not account for spread and slippage impact on short-term breakout trading; actual performance may fall far below backtesting results
improvements: 加入最大回撤限制和最大马丁格尔层数硬限制，超过阈值强制停止交易并重置手数
增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX指标），仅在趋势确认时执行突破入场，减少震荡市虚假信号
improvements_en: Add a maximum drawdown limit and a hard cap on Martingale progression levels; stop trading and reset lot size when thresholds are exceeded
Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX indicator) to only execute breakout entries when the trend is confirmed, reducing false signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 马丁格尔仓位翻倍机制在连续亏损时手数呈指数增长，极易导致爆仓
突破策略在震荡行情中产生大量虚假信号，加剧马丁格尔递进层数的累积
缺乏账户级别的硬性风控措施，无法强制终止危险的资金递进
risk_points_en: The Martingale lot-doubling mechanism causes exponential position growth during consecutive losses,极易leading to account blowup
Breakout strategy generates numerous false signals in ranging markets, accelerating the accumulation of Martingale progression levels
Lacks account-level hard risk controls that could forcibly terminate dangerous position progression
